exactness.equality_certificate: Each pair (not u or v) and (u or not v) proves u=v in every model.
exactness.quotient: Replacing all variables in one equality class by a representative preserves satisfiability and gives polynomial model lifting by copying the representative value.
exactness.connected_family_effect: For each of the five variable tracks in R44BS, all k block variables collapse to one representative. Backbone clauses become tautologies. The k local block copies become duplicate copies of one base sibling and deduplicate to the R44AS base sibling pair.
exactness.transport: R44BQ-K5 then discovers the exact support-5 signed transport on the quotient pair.
exactness.lift: A quotient target model lifts to the original connected target sibling by assigning every member of each equality class the representative value.

complexity.equality_detection: Polynomial in encoded CNF size; explicit clause-pair hashing plus union-find.
complexity.transport_discovery: O(n_q^5 * poly(N_q)) with quotient variable count n_q=5 on this family; equivalently fixed-K polynomial discovery.

rank_effect.note: The quotient is used to discover and certify safe deletion; the retained original child already satisfies the required lower maxdef rank.

next_exact_question: Construct or characterize a connected maxdef-critical sibling family with growing transport complexity after exhaustive polynomial binary-congruence quotienting; equivalently, move to CONGRUENCE-RIGID connected critical cores.
